hero.eyebrow: Engineered for Uncompromising Speed, Security, and Scalability
hero.title: High-Performance WordPress Plugin Suite & Digital Tools
hero.subtitle: VibePress Studio engineers enterprise-grade WordPress performance plugins and digital tools built on native database architecture (wp_posts & wp_postmeta) to replace bloated SaaS systems with rock-solid, production-grade solutions.

pillars.title: Native Architecture & Zero Query Bloat
pillars.desc: Built natively upon WordPress standard database tables (wp_posts and wp_postmeta) with 24h transient caching, preserving sub-millisecond execution speeds under traffic surges.

pillars.title: Automated Compliance & Ban Protection
pillars.desc: Smart ToS Uncloaking automatically detects Amazon and eBay links to keep accounts safe under Amazon §6, paired with accessible FTC disclosure banners.

pillars.title: Dynamic Routing & Direct Monetization
pillars.desc: Route visitors dynamically by OS, device, browser, or language, run weighted A/B split tests, and accept direct payments via Stripe Checkout without WooCommerce bloat.

pillars.title: 100% Local Data Sovereignty & Defense
pillars.desc: Bot-filtered click tracking stored locally with GDPR IP anonymization, daily broken link health scanning, and 1-click competitor migration engines.

standards.title: Built to Highest Industry Engineering Standards

items.heading: WordPress Core Standards (WPCS)
items.body: Engineered in strict adherence to WordPress Core Coding Standards (WPCS), PSR-4 object-oriented modular patterns, and PSR-12 formatting rules.

items.heading: Enterprise Performance & Routing
items.body: Powered by top-priority rewrite rules, 24h transient caching, and optimized database queries with sub-millisecond redirect speeds.

items.heading: Data Privacy & Cookie-Less Architecture
items.body: Zero third-party cloud tracking pixels, optional IPv4/IPv6 IP anonymization, bot filtering, and 100% local database ownership.
